description: This PHP source file defines the Marketing model class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform's admin backend. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving marketing records and associated reports from the database.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: Represents the marketing data management within the admin panel, providing functionalities to manipulate marketing records and their reports in the database, extending the core Model class.

methods.name: addMarketing
methods.description: Creates a new marketing record in the database with provided data.

methods.name: editMarketing
methods.description: Updates an existing marketing record identified by marketing_id.

methods.name: deleteMarketing
methods.description: Deletes the marketing record and associated reports from the database.

methods.name: getMarketing
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific marketing record by its ID.

methods.name: getMarketingByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a marketing record based on a unique code.

methods.name: getMarketings
methods.description: Returns a list of marketing records, optionally filtered and sorted.

methods.name: getTotalMarketings
methods.description: Counts total marketing records matching filters.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Removes all report entries related to a specific marketing ID.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Gets reports associated with a specific marketing record.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Counts total report entries for a given marketing ID.
